# Breathing, airway and the ventilator coupling

[All modules](README.md) · [Known misses](../validation/known-misses.md#breathing) · 4 source files, 1493 lines · 32 test files

## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

This module schedules every breath and runs the respiratory side of each tick: one breath driver for spontaneous
breathing, bag-valve-mask, the built-in ventilator, an external ventilator frame or apnoea, airway states that decide
whether a breath exchanges gas, reaches the CO2 sampler or moves the chest, and the gas-exchange, capnogram and
impedance outputs that follow. It also supplies the breath signal and pleural pressure the haemodynamics read. A
clinician-educator reads it to see how airway events and ventilation modes reach the monitor; an embedding developer
reads it for the tick order, the ventilator link and the events it emits.
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

- One ground-truth breath scheduler feeds the capnogram, gas exchange, the impedance channel, the haemodynamic breath
  signal and the breath events; its source is spontaneous, bag-valve-mask, ventilator, external or none (brief §4.7;
  research 03 §7; `l2/resp/driver.ts`).
- A spontaneous breath has an inspiratory fraction of 0.38 (I:E about 1:1.6), a negative pleural swing of 4 cmH2O and
  a 5 % breath-to-breath jitter of period and volume (`l2/resp/driver.ts`).
- Passive expiration has τ = R·C = 0.5 s; a volume-control breath with no set limit is pressure-limited at 40 cmH2O,
  the anaesthesia-ventilator factory default (Dräger Primus, GE Aisys manuals; `l2/resp/driver.ts`).
- An external ventilator drives inspiration once flow exceeds 0.05 L/s, and 5 s without a frame counts as apnoea
  (brief §7.6; `l2/resp/driver.ts`).
- The breath signal for the haemodynamics is u(t) = 0.5 + swing, zero-mean over a cycle, with a swing of 1.0 for a
  500 mL positive-pressure breath at a compliance of 50 mL/cmH2O; spontaneous breaths swing negative, and apnoea gives
  0.5 (`l2/resp/driver.ts`).
- Gas exchange uses cardiac output as a ratio to this patient's own normal output, so a small patient at rest is not
  treated as in low-flow shock (`l2/resp/pipeline.ts`).
- The breath's mechanics are measured at end-inspiration and end-expiration on a copy of the lung state, with the
  static volumes and forced expiration updated at 1 Hz (`l2/resp/pipeline.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->
